digest.component_or_area: bridge fsck command and store auditing
propositions: Remove orphaned, duplicates, and stale output cells that depend on legacy SYNC events never written by rebar, as these checks permanently short-circuit and produce no useful results
Add store_integrity offline audit that validates forward and reverse binding index agreement without network access, with six distinct finding types for index inconsistencies

Implement unknown_event_types detection using git grep against committed tickets ref without requiring a tickets checkout, handling both JSON spacing variants and reporting only top-level event_type mismatches

Define fail-closed Git operational semantics where missing executables, missing refs, malformed output, grep exit codes >=2, and candidate read failures raise RebarError with returncode=2 and CLI exit 2
Make store_integrity findings gate fsck exit status to 1 while keeping unknown_event_types and binding_drift as non-gating informational results

Preserve all live BRIDGE_ALERT event emission, TicketState reducer, and bridge-status compatibility entrypoint unchanged while updating all callers, MCP schema, CLI, and test fixtures to the new output contract
